dedupe_keys.name: 主要河川 dams reservoirs and flood defences series on bodik odcs

description: 主要河川 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). 京都府統計書 第１章 土地・気象. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 3 publishers. Its tags are 京都府政策企画部, 企画統計課, 土地_気象, 統計書, ３つ星オープンデータ. It offers 38 resource(s) in csv, rdf, xls, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
